item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q020_syntaxin_fragment_reclassification","answer":"In SCOPe 2.08 these entries should be read as one rat syntaxin-1A N-terminal-domain lineage, not as independent evidence that a generic three-helix fragment defines a different fold or function. The complete-domain reference 3c98B and the automated 1dn1B domain d1dn1b_ are classified as all-alpha proteins, STAT-like fold a.47, t-SNARE proteins superfamily a.47.2, and t-SNARE proteins family a.47.2.1. The older fragment structures d1br0a_ and d1ez3a_/d1ez3b_/d1ez3c_ have the same a.47.2.1 family and the same Syntaxin 1A N-terminal domain protein/species placement, but each carries the SCOPe homology heterogeneity flag `ms`, meaning it is missing secondary structures amounting to less than one third of the common domain; their comments also mark them as three-helical fragments similar to one spectrin repeat. Therefore 1br0 and 1ez3 are representative fragment envelopes inside the syntaxin N-terminal domain, while 1dn1B represents the full domain architecture. Homology/function transfer is appropriate within the syntaxin/t-SNARE family assignment, but the fragment-only three-helix similarity should not be promoted to a complete-domain boundary, a count of domains in syntaxin, or a homology claim to unrelated spectrin-like or other all-alpha FATCAT neighbors. For template use, 1br0A and 1ez3A/B/C can only cover the N-terminal fragment they contain; a full-domain template should instead be a full a.47.2.1 syntaxin N-terminal domain such as d1dn1b_ or its 100%-identity all-chain representative 3c98B.","evidence_used":["get_scop_domains: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1dn1b_, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1dn1b_/parents, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1dn1b_/homology","get_scop_domains: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3c98b_, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3c98b_/parents, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3c98b_/homology","get_scop_domains: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1br0a_, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1br0a_/parents, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1br0a_/homology","get_scop_domains: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1ez3a_, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1ez3a_/parents, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1ez3a_/homology","get_scop_domains: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1ez3b_, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1ez3b_/parents, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1ez3b_/homology","get_scop_domains: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1ez3c_, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1ez3c_/parents, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1ez3c_/homology","get_scop_chain_hits: /api/v1/releases/2.08/chains/1dn1B/hits, /api/v1/releases/2.08/chains/3c98B/hits"]}]}
